title: Each song's year in a journey, with where it came from
description: One row per song on the journey, no more and no fewer (checked by code). MusicBrainz is only the first guess; a writer or a person corrects it, corrected_from keeps the old year and url the page that settles it. A year nobody could find is null, never made up. Nothing here writes the song bank: liner-notes dates-apply does that, into your copies of the songs.

song.x-reply: the song's id, exactly as in the inputs
